input.question: Was a dedicated broker-generated identifier for topology description kept or removed in favor of identifying topology by topologyEpoch and group creation timestamp?

content.content: {"result":"{\"answer\":\"Based on the context filesystem, I found the answer to your question:\\n\\n**The dedicated broker-generated identifier for topology description was REMOVED in favor of identifying topology by topologyEpoch and group creation timestamp.**\\n\\nThis decision is documented in the KIP-1331 (Streams Group Topology Description Plugin) design discussions:\\n\\nIn the **May 11, 2026 response** from Lucas Brutschy in `/store/events/2026/05/11/mail-bfae351428945364a45fb155-856deba8.md`, he states:\\n\\n> \\\"MJS1) I dropped the UUID, as it introduced more complexities than it solved.\\\"\\n\\nMore specifically, in response to Andrew Schofield's concern (AJS7):\\n\\n> \\\"AJS7) Good point. This, in part, prompted me to bring back a previous version of the design, without the topology decription ID. Now, the topology description is created using only the topologyEpoch and a group creation timestamp. Then, the plugin can trivially implement concurrency control: The plugin can decide to store all versions, which means updates for separate topology epochs are independent. Or it can just store the latest one, which means that a topology description that comes later in the (groupCreationTimestamp, topologyEpoch) order takes preference over any previous update.\\\"\\n\\nThis decision was further confirmed in Lucas's follow-up on **May 13, 2026** in `/store/events/2026/05/13/mail-154b667449f3621f5f52519e-9d9d548d.md`, where he noted that the topology identification now uses the combination of `topologyEpoch` and `group creation timestamp` as a composite key instead of a dedicated UUID.\",\"error\":null,\"files\":[\"events/2026/05/26/github-api-apache-kafka-review-comment-PRRC_kwDOACG9q87FDtnH-9a3e51e6.md\",\"events/2026/04/21/mail-b032a077f4926699fc0dcac3-08f0c7ff.md\",\"events/2026/04/21/mail-6f6c0f8772c38ffe4beaa1bc-bdfd7c34.md\",\"events/2026/05/27/jira-13652562-created-348feffe.md\",\"events/2026/05/27/mail-28fad9411a7a5c1f1e613e18-79e94f53.md\",\"events/2026/05/27/mail-ae1db1b9a304bc083f9951ec-ffa237ce.md\",\"events/2026/05/08/mail-a1e140da3fd170468e40f522-615a972a.md\",\"events/2026/05/08/mail-d92ed6b21420a5d5b494b7f0-e17a9067.md\",\"events/2026/05/09/mail-6a6d720fd3b3e9c082d5a62a-4ec8f025.md\",\"events/2026/05/11/mail-bfae351428945364a45fb155-856deba8.md\",\"events/2026/05/12/mail-54b7a95c4e0a9850e6218625-dc0e34ba.md\",\"events/2026/05/13/mail-154b667449f3621f5f52519e-9d9d548d.md\"],\"seconds\":37.99,\"truncated\":false,\"turns\":2,\"usage\":{\"cache_read_tokens\":182441,\"cache_write_tokens\":53471,\"cost_usd\":0.1387451,\"input_tokens\":74,\"output_tokens\":2697}}"}

{"answer":"Based on the context filesystem, I found the answer to your question:

**The dedicated broker-generated identifier for topology description was REMOVED in favor of identifying topology by topologyEpoch and group creation timestamp.**

This decision is documented in the KIP-1331 (Streams Group Topology Description Plugin) design discussions:

In the **May 11, 2026 response** from Lucas Brutschy in `/store/events/2026/05/11/mail-bfae351428945364a45fb155-856deba8.md`, he states:

> "MJS1) I dropped the UUID, as it introduced more complexities than it solved."

More specifically, in response to Andrew Schofield's concern (AJS7):

> "AJS7) Good point. This, in part, prompted me to bring back a previous version of the design, without the topology decription ID. Now, the topology description is created using only the topologyEpoch and a group creation timestamp. Then, the plugin can trivially implement concurrency control: The plugin can decide to store all versions, which means updates for separate topology epochs are independent. Or it can just store the latest one, which means that a topology description that comes later in the (groupCreationTimestamp, topologyEpoch) order takes preference over any previous update."

This decision was further confirmed in Lucas's follow-up on **May 13, 2026** in `/store/events/2026/05/13/mail-154b667449f3621f5f52519e-9d9d548d.md`, where he noted that the topology identification now uses the combination of `topologyEpoch` and `group creation timestamp` as a composite key instead of a dedicated UUID.","error":null,"files":["events/2026/05/26/github-api-apache-kafka-review-comment-PRRC_kwDOACG9q87FDtnH-9a3e51e6.md","events/2026/04/21/mail-b032a077f4926699fc0dcac3-08f0c7ff.md","events/2026/04/21/mail-6f6c0f8772c38ffe4beaa1bc-bdfd7c34.md","events/2026/05/27/jira-13652562-created-348feffe.md","events/2026/05/27/mail-28fad9411a7a5c1f1e613e18-79e94f53.md","events/2026/05/27/mail-ae1db1b9a304bc083f9951ec-ffa237ce.md","events/2026/05/08/mail-a1e140da3fd170468e40f522-615a972a.md","events/2026/05/08/mail-d92ed6b21420a5d5b494b7f0-e17a9067.md","events/2026/05/09/mail-6a6d720fd3b3e9c082d5a62a-4ec8f025.md","events/2026/05/11/mail-bfae351428945364a45fb155-856deba8.md","events/2026/05/12/mail-54b7a95c4e0a9850e6218625-dc0e34ba.md","events/2026/05/13/mail-154b667449f3621f5f52519e-9d9d548d.md"],"seconds":37.99,"truncated":false,"turns":2,"usage":{"cache_read_tokens":182441,"cache_write_tokens":53471,"cost_usd":0.1387451,"input_tokens":74,"output_tokens":2697}}
